title: Star map
description: 20 000 stars are generated on the CPU. GPU picking finds the star under the pointer each frame. Its found() accessor lights that star through a 'use gpu' glow field in the same frame. Readback handles clicks, and the chosen star gets a callout pinned beside it, drawn over the finished frame: a ring and a leader out to a plate, shaded from signed distances, with its name over its distance from the core typing on in the kit's MSDF text. Bloom and the final pass add glow.
line: 20 000 stars; the one under the pointer is picked on the GPU.
hint: hover a star · click to choose · drag to orbit · wheel to zoom
